productRequirement.summary: Build a Northstar workspace Projects management experience. Users need to browse and search projects, create a project, inspect/edit project details, and archive a project with confirmation.
userGoals: Browse projects with project identity, owner, status, and a record-specific details action.
Search projects by project name or project key and understand the current result count.
Create a project with a required name, required short project key, and starting status.
Open project details, edit the project name/key/status, save changes, and preserve entered edits after a recoverable save failure.
Archive a project only after an explicit consequential confirmation.
dataFixtures: Billing revamp — key BILL — owner Sara Ahmed — Active.
Mobile onboarding — key MOB — owner Omar Khalid — Active.
Research hub — key RSH — owner Daniel Chen — Draft.
The project key is intrinsically LTR even when the surrounding UI is Arabic.
requiredStates: Create-project modal with valid, invalid, pending/failure, retry, and success outcomes.
Project detail open with selected-row association.
presentationModes: Wide Application Shell and compact/narrow directory presentation.
For any contextual-detail behavior that approved guidance marks unresolved on narrow screens, report the unresolved decision instead of inventing a new model.

executionRules: Read only the shared agent-context allowlist from the test-pack manifest; do not read any denied source.
Do not inspect git history, pull-request diffs, other branches, tags, or earlier implementations to recover an answer.
Do not use external search or external code examples to locate this repository's previous implementation.
Use only public governed package APIs authorized by the supplied contracts and guidance.
Do not add or modify design-system components, contracts, patterns, tokens, or canonical guidance.
Write implementation files only inside the task writeRoot.
Use governed tokens when available and explain every remaining local raw dimension or local CSS decision in AUTHORING-REPORT.md.
When supplied authorities do not resolve a decision, record it as unresolved in AUTHORING-REPORT.md instead of guessing.
Do not ask a human to correct the implementation during the run.

checks.statement: Use governed components/patterns for shell, heading, search, table/empty, detail, form controls, feedback, and modal confirmation rather than custom substitutes.
Do not invent public component props, variants, states, slots, or events.
Any local CSS must stay within composition/product ownership and be explained in the authoring report.
Do not use unexplained raw product colors or raw dimensions when governed tokens already own the decision.
Follow approved Directory, Modal List → Detail, and Create Flow composition guidance without copying prior implementation source.
Preserve governed labels, row-action naming, modal semantics, focus containment, inert background behavior, and focus restoration.
Use logical RTL/LTR layout and keep project keys intrinsically LTR without forcing the surrounding UI LTR.
Directory controls respond at the governed shell boundary and unresolved narrow contextual detail is escalated rather than invented.
The result should read as a coherent Northstar Projects management screen using the supplied product brief and governed system.

expectedEscalations: Narrow-screen contextual project detail presentation is unresolved by current approved guidance and should be reported rather than implemented as an invented drawer, sheet, or route.
contaminationSignals: copying existing prototype/story class names or answer-source code
